tx.sign.description: Sign a Tempo (0x76) transaction as a secp256k1 sender or a keychain access key, optionally co-signed by a fee payer, and return the signing hashes, raw bytes, hash and sender.

tx.decode.description: Decode a signed Tempo transaction, recover its sender (the root account for keychain signatures) and fee payer, and return its fields and hash. Malformed or non-canonical input is a decode_error.

key_authorization.sign.description: Sign a key authorization with a root secp256k1 key and return its signing hash, signature envelope and RLP.

signature.recover.description: Return the account a serialized Tempo signature envelope (secp256k1, P256, WebAuthn, keychain V1/V2) signs a hash for, as the node's TempoSignature::recover_signer decides it.
